decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ introduction already states that Chainlink VRF selects winners on-chain and that results are verifiable on Basescan, so no additional candidate Event is needed.
The VRF decision governs the separate winner-selection Requirement and does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, funding, or recurrence state.
Selecting winners through Chainlink VRF does not change the winner-initiated claim method, Winners page announcement, or one-click payout interaction.
The VRF provider and verification details belong to the separate winner-selection Requirement and do not alter the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or sales-count trigger.
The prize winner-selection mechanism does not change referral-milestone badge thresholds, destination, or on-chain recording.
Chainlink VRF prize selection is unrelated to the Transak provider, payment methods, fiat conversion, or wallet and crypto requirements.
The VRF selection details do not change the mint price, affiliate commission, founder allocation, or prize-pool funding destinations.
The winner-selection provider does not alter the enabled royalty, flat $10 amount, visibility, or use of royalty proceeds.
Chainlink VRF remains compatible with ticket-weighted winning chances and does not change Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, or secondary-sale rules.
Chainlink VRF remains compatible with ticket-weighted winning chances and does not change Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility window, reset, carryover, or secondary-sale rules.
The prize winner-selection implementation does not change which NFT access, referral-code, badge, or expired-ticket state transfers on a secondary sale.
The VRF decision does not change the required metadata fields for ticket counters, permanent badges, or the NFT referral-code attribute.
